content.text: TODAYOURIST was honored to accompany the team of the Red Plains in the tour – meaningful vacations in two provinces of beautiful sea – Funky with many memorable experiences
Discovering Wonder Island Paradise Co with clear water and beautiful white sandfields
Check-in Emo Wind – one of the most beautiful sunset sights in the Middle Kingdom with spectacular natural landscape
Discovering the Disk Stone – Winning Fuji Yeung's unique natural scene
A Visit to the Church of Malgallo – One of the oldest Churchs of Vietnam with its architectural record
Check-in Tower Nhangfeng – New City Tour symbol
Archive beautiful moments together during the journey
Enjoy the fascinating specials of the Sea of Census – Fujipe
Buying local goods as a gift for family and relatives
Shared in the warm, happy Gala Dinner program with many social activities, connection and memorable moments with the great Rose family

TODAYYURIST honors the leadership and the entire team of the United States of America's May Council to have a great deal of health, happiness and success in the work as well as life. Thank you for your confidence in the selection of TODAYTURIST on this journey!
